frames.name: rts-build.playtest.json
frames.regions:
ALIGNMENT: BEFORE r1/r2 and PINNED r1/r2 (1280x720) show the same state (ORE 620, GAS 166, SUPPLY 23/30, CLOCK 00:05; 'BARRACKS ORDERED...' banner; Strike Group 1 SELECTED Barracks 850/850, SITE 8%, IDLE) and the same object positions. No hostile unit, order/destination marker or damage cue appears in any frame, and repeats within each arm look identical.
GROUND/TONE: the lit oval (x~100-1100,y~130-620) goes from dim taupe on charcoal to light khaki on mauve-grey. The grid stays crisp. The lower-left shadow region (x0-650,y~490-720) is still clearly darker than the lit floor, now with more grid detail visible. I see no banding, grain or flat white field.
STRUCTURES: Command Core x515-651,y345-443 has a pale lit top, with dark side facets and cyan accent boxes kept, so it has more depth than BEFORE's uniformly dark body. Barracks x675-790,y395-490 keeps its bright roof, teal pad, white slash (x~733-757,y~428-445), shaded right face and dark left-base contact shadow (x~672-700,y~430-455). Left structure x298-378,y372-442 and tower x594-665,y230-288 stay grounded.
RINGS: the Command Core (x515-651,y358-443), Barracks base (x683-780,y440-485), left structure (x298-378,y405-442) and tower (x596-664,y265-287) rings are brighter cyan strokes with a visible dark edge. They are clearly stronger than BEFORE's thin muted-teal rings, with no broken arcs.
BARS/SMALL UNITS: building bars (x547-619,y343; x696-768,y408; x594-665,y235), the dark bar (x302-374,y381) and the two idle-cluster bars (orange x818-855,y317; pale green x838-875,y327) are present at the same extents in all four raws. Cluster bodies (x800-890,y320-392) are paler but keep dark chests, teal pads and contact shadow. Crystals (x430-545,y220-320) are more saturated and none are missing. Ore piles (x498-540,y295-327) and harvesters (x395-432,y358-398) are present; the tan/gold piles sit warm-on-warm against the lighter khaki, which is a spot to watch but shows no visible loss.
HUD: the resources panel (x16-302,y16-64), banner (x880-1264,y16-64), minimap (x1088-1264,y303-497), button rows (x971-1264,y448-626), Strike Group (x16-304,y542-704) and PAUSE are all legible, with higher text and border contrast on near-black than on BEFORE's teal. Minimap L outline, marker (1102,353) and blob (x1103-1165,y420-476) are unchanged. VANGUARD/MENDER overlap the lower minimap in all four raws. The new hint strip (x944-1264,y634-664) covers only floor/grid, with no cue under it in BEFORE. The pool sliver (x~930-1065,y~703-720) lies below it and is unchanged.
frames.reason: AFTER moves toward the Unreal L9 panels. The lit floor now reads as mid-high-key daylight instead of dim dusk. Structure tops are bright with the facet/shadow ramp intact, and I see no newly flat or clipped white patch at native scale. Contact shadows stay dark against the lighter floor. Material depth, ring definition and HUD contrast all improve, so this is not brightness alone. Subjects, team colour, resources, rings, bars, minimap and HUD text are preserved or stronger, with no state mismatch between arms. The only open item is the pale-or-orange thin bar against lighter ground (see contrastWatchDecision), which I could not confirm as fainter. No hard contradiction.

frames.name: rts-orders.playtest.json
frames.regions:
ALIGNMENT: all four raws show ORE 790, GAS 150, SUPPLY 23/30, CLOCK 00:11 and Strike Group 20 SELECTED Surveyor 65/65 IDLE,MOVE. Camera and object positions are the same, and there is no hostile unit, order or destination marker. Repeats within each arm look identical. The one arm-to-arm difference is the tank ring (below), which I could not attribute with certainty.
TANK/HOVER: on the tank (x713-767,y262-313), the bar (x722-758,y272) is unchanged. A base ring (x~718-765,y~296-316) is readable in both PINNED repeats, but I cannot make it out in either BEFORE repeat. The HUD state is identical, so it is likely the dark-backed ring now reading on the lighter floor; attribution is unproven, and it is not a regression either way. On the hover vehicle (x815-870,y270-306), the dark bar (x826-862,y273) now sits on lighter floor and reads more clearly. Its arc (x~822-840,y~296-306) is present in all four.
DRONE CLUSTER (x795-900,y312-398): about seven staggered pale bars (x798-896,y316-360) sit at the same positions and lengths in all four raws; the count is approximate because bars and bodies overlap. In PINNED they are paler mint, partly over pale drone tops, but each stays continuous and countable. Ring arcs (x800-892,y355-395) are continuous and brighter cyan. Bodies keep dark chests, teal pads and lower-left contact shadows, with no merging, blur or ghosting.
STRUCTURES/RINGS/GROUND: same findings as the build pose. Rings are brighter and dark-edged at the Command Core, Barracks base, left structure and tower. Tops are lit, facets and shadows are retained, and the shadow region (x0-700,y~500-720) is still clearly darker than the lit khaki floor. Crystals are more saturated.
MINIMAP (x1088-1264,y303-497): no VANGUARD/MENDER overlap in this pose. The complete blob (x1103-1165,y420-478), marker (1102,353), L outline and frame are unchanged. Only the panel fill changes from teal to near-black.
HUD: resources, Strike Group (x16-304,y565-704: Surveyor, Utility drone, 65/65, full progress track x28-292,y~646, IDLE,MOVE), button rows and PAUSE are all legible. The hint strip (x944-1264,y634-664) covers only empty floor/grid; the pool sliver (y>=703) lies below it.
frames.reason: Same L9-directed gain as the build pose: daylight-key floor, retained facet and shadow depth, no visible clipped white, grounded contact, and stronger rings including the tank base ring. This pose has the densest tiny-cue cluster (20 selected). There the bars, arcs and bodies are all present at the same extents, but they are equal rather than clearly stronger. Pale mint bars over pale drone tops are the exact watch scenario. I could not confirm any bar, arc or body as fainter, and HUD and minimap cues are intact. No hard contradiction.

reason: Subset review of rts-build and rts-orders only, not a whole-kit decision. I opened both sheets, all eight raw repeats (run1s of both arms, plus both run2s, read twice), both reference boards and the three watch JSONs. I used the Unreal panels as the L9 target: the far-right panel of harness-L9-source.png and the third column of harness-L9-full-sun60.png. The ThreeNative panels were used only as harness trend. In both poses BEFORE and PINNED are state-matched and repeatable. AFTER moves the frame from dim, murky taupe toward a bright daylight key with retained facet and shadow depth, dark contact shadows and no visible flat clipped white. Rings are visibly stronger, and the HUD is more legible on near-black panels, which is the pinned intent. Bars, small bodies, resources, minimap and text are preserved. The hint strip covers only floor and grid in both poses. I found no confirmed fainter, missing or blurred gameplay cue and no hard contradiction. Residual risk remains: thin pale or orange bars against the lighter ground (watch decision below). Temporal exposure stability is not verified here.
limitations: Method: only Read was used. I viewed the 1280x720 raws at native size but could not zoom, crop or sample pixels. Coordinates are eyeballed to about +/-3-5 px, and the downsampled sheets (2560x1568 shown at 2000x1225) were used for layout only. I could not resolve whether the 3-px bars and 1-px arcs carry a dark backing; it is obvious only on the large rings. I also could not verify that small bright patches (Barracks roof slash x~733-757,y~428-445, pale drone tops) stay below 255, so no flat clipped patch is visible but a few-pixel clip is not excluded. TEMPORAL: these are static endpoint frames. Exposure settling, pumping, flicker, adaptation, audio and unseen gameplay are NOT verified by this review, and matching repeats establish endpoint repeatability only. Not assessable in these two poses: hostile units and enemy colours, order/destination markers, damage or partial-fill bars (all bars look full-length, and the orange build bar is the only non-green one), and what the hint strip would hide in other poses. The supplied L*, Y-ratio and Michelson numbers come from the AI-attack pose only; I measured nothing in build or orders, so applying them here is inference from the same colours and floor. The tank-ring difference between arms (PINNED only) has unproven attribution. The RTS has no sky or spheres, so the L9 comparison is limited to tonal placement, highlight shoulder, shading depth and contact grounding. I credit nothing to the resolution pin and cannot verify scaler state from stills. The teal-to-near-black panel change matches the stated pinned HUD intent and was judged only on legibility. This subset does not establish or reject whole-kit improvement.
contrastWatchDecision:
I did not confirm any whole bar, ring or infantry cue in rts-build or rts-orders as weaker (actualCueRegression=false), but residual uncertainty remains.

Preserved or stronger:
- Rings: the Command Core ring (x515-651,y358-443), Barracks base ring (x683-780,y440-485), left structure ring (x298-378,y405-442) and tower ring (x596-664,y265-287) are brighter with a visible dark edge. The dark backing clearly helps these large rings. Drone arcs (x800-892,y355-395) are continuous and brighter. The tank base ring (x~718-765,y~296-316) is readable only in PINNED.
- Bars: all are present at identical positions and lengths in every raw.
  - build: x547-619,y343; x696-768,y408; x594-665,y235; cluster orange x818-855,y317 and green x838-875,y327.
  - orders adds: tank x722-758,y272; hover dark bar x826-862,y273; about seven cluster bars x798-896,y316-360.
  - The dark bars (x302-374,y381; x826-862,y273) gain separation on the lighter floor. The pale mint bars stay continuous and are still the brightest thin strokes.
- Infantry (x795-900,y312-398): dark chests, teal pads, contact shadows and cool-vs-warm hue separation from the khaki are kept. I saw no merging, blur or loss.

Unresolved, not confirmed:
- Where pale mint or orange bars cross the palest tops or sit on light khaki, the lightness step is plausibly smaller than BEFORE's. The places are the top drone heads (~x827-846,y322-337), the Barracks roof edge (x696-768,y408) and the orange build bar (x818-855,y317, warm on warm khaki). That matches the supplied AI-attack numbers (L* 25.9->20.8; Y-ratio 2.83->2.02; absolute Y separation up).
- I saw no bar that looked visibly fainter or had a missing segment, hue still separates mint and orange from khaki, and I could not resolve any thin-bar backing at native scale.
- The orange build bar is the weakest-lightness candidate. If the lead counts any relative-lightness drop as 'weaker', those bars are the cues at issue. I did not confirm that visually, and I did not measure it.
